question: Which of the following is an example of system software?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windows Operating System.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Windows operating system is owned by **Microsoft.**
 
• The first operating system **Windows 1.0 **was released on **November 20, 1985.**
 
• The latest operating system **windows 11** was launched in **2021**.
